"WITH dep_plan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,
        f1.PLAN_TIME,
        f1.IS_OFF_IN
    FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1

      AND FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
),

    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,
        f1.PLAN_TIME,
        f1.IS_OFF_IN

    WHERE IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
      AND TRUNC(PLAN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
      AND FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_plan) AS depart_plan_flights,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_plan) AS arrive_plan_flights,

sql.执行航班量(航班吞吐量):
WITH dep_flights AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,
        f1.PLAN_TIME,
        f1.IS_OFF_IN
    FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
    LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
    WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
      AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
      AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
      AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
),
arr_flights AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,
        f1.PLAN_TIME,
        f1.IS_OFF_IN
    FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
    LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
    WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
      AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
      AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
      AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_flights) AS depart_flights,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_flights) AS arrive_flights,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_flights) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_flights) AS total_flights
FROM DUAL;

sql.旅客吞吐量:
WITH 
-- 进港去重航班
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        a.FLIGHT_ID,
        a.EXEC_DATE,
        a.CRAFT_NO,
        a.FLIGHT_NO,
        a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
        a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
        a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.FLIGHT_NO,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) a
    WHERE a.rn = 1
),
-- 出港去重航班
dep_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FLIGHT_ID,
        d.EXEC_DATE
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
-- 计算进港旅客量
arr_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(fp.ADULT_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.CHILDREN_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.BABY_COUNT, 0)) AS arrival_pax
    FROM arr_unique a
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON a.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND a.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND a.FLIGHT_NO = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
),
-- 计算出港旅客量
dep_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(t.DEP_DPSR_DEPE_NUM, 0)) AS departure_pax
    FROM dep_unique d
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL t ON d.FLIGHT_ID = t.FLIGHT_ID
)
SELECT 
    arr_pax.arrival_pax,
    dep_pax.departure_pax,
    arr_pax.arrival_pax + dep_pax.departure_pax AS total_pax
FROM arr_pax, dep_pax;

 COUNT(CASE WHEN attribute='2402' THEN 1 END) AS regional_flight_count,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(actual_time,'HH24:MI') BETWEEN '00:00' AND '05:00' THEN 1 END) AS night_tail_flight_count,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND DEP_ON_TIME='Y' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN 1 END),0),2) AS dep_on_time_rate,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND AGENCY='210' AND attribute='2403' AND TAKEOFF_ON_TIME='Y' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND AGENCY='210' AND attribute='2403' THEN 1 END),0),2) AS ground_takeoff_on_time_rate,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND AGENCY='210' AND attribute='2403' AND RELEASE_ON_TIME='Y' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND AGENCY='210' AND attribute='2403' THEN 1 END),0),2) AS ground_release_on_time_rate,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN FLIGHT_ON_TIME='Y' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS flight_on_time_rate,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND CLEARANCE_DELAY_TIME>0 THEN 1 END) AS release_delay_count,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND TAKEOFF_DELAY_TIME>0 THEN 1 END) AS takeoff_delay_count,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN FLIGHT_DELAY_TIME>0 THEN 1 END) AS flight_delay_count,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND CLEARANCE_DELAY_TIME BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1 END) AS short_delay_5m_count,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND DEP_DELAY_TIME>0 THEN DEP_DELAY_TIME END),2) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN direction='A' AND ARR_DELAY_TIME>0 THEN ARR_DELAY_TIME END),2) AS avg_arr_delay_minutes,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_REMOTE='N' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS bridge_stand_rate_all,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_REMOTE='Y' THEN 1 END) AS remote_stand_flights,
 COUNT(*) AS peak_hour_movements,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN REAL_TAXI_OUT_TIME END),2) AS avg_taxi_out_minutes,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' AND REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME<=TARGT_BLOCK_OFF_TIME THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN 1 END),0),2) AS block_off_on_time_rate
FROM native_flights WHERE rn=1

sql.跨日过站原生关联独立汇总:
WITH pairs AS (
 SELECT af.EXEC_DATE AS arr_exec_date,df.EXEC_DATE AS dep_exec_date,ar.REAL_LANDIN_TIME AS arrival_time,
 dr.RELEASE_ON_TIME,af.CRAFT_TYPE_ICAO_CD AS arr_type,df.CRAFT_TYPE_ICAO_CD AS dep_type,
 (CAST(dr.SCHEME_TAKEOFF_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(ar.SCHEME_LANDIN_TIME AS DATE))*1440 AS planned_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME>ar.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_blocks,
 (CAST(dr.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(ar.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME AS DATE))*1440 AS service_minutes,
 CASE WHEN ar.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME>ar.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME THEN (CAST(ar.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(ar.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS bridge_minutes,
 CASE WHEN ar.DEPARTURE_END_TIME>ar.DEPARTURE_START_TIME THEN (CAST(ar.DEPARTURE_END_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(ar.DEPARTURE_START_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS departure_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_END_BOARD_TIME>dr.REAL_BEGIN_BOARD_TIME THEN (CAST(dr.REAL_END_BOARD_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(dr.REAL_BEGIN_BOARD_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS board_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_END_CLEAN_TIME>dr.REAL_START_CLEAN_TIME THEN (CAST(dr.REAL_END_CLEAN_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(dr.REAL_START_CLEAN_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS clean_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_MEAL_END_TIME>dr.REAL_MEAL_START_TIME THEN (CAST(dr.REAL_MEAL_END_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(dr.REAL_MEAL_START_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS meal_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_END_SUPPLY_TIME>dr.REAL_START_SUPPLY_TIME THEN (CAST(dr.REAL_END_SUPPLY_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(dr.REAL_START_SUPPLY_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS supply_minutes,
 CASE WHEN dr.REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME>dr.REAL_START_DEICE_TIME THEN (CAST(dr.REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME AS DATE)-CAST(dr.REAL_START_DEICE_TIME AS DATE))*1440 END AS deice_minutes
 FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT af JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT ar ON ar.FLIGHT_ID=af.FLIGHT_ID
 JOIN FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT df ON df.FLIGHT_ID=ar.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT dr ON dr.FLIGHT_ID=df.FLIGHT_ID
 WHERE af.IS_OFF_IN='A' AND df.IS_OFF_IN='D' AND af.CRAFT_NO=df.CRAFT_NO
 AND af.FLIGHT_TASK_CD<>'A/N' AND df.FLIGHT_TASK_CD<>'A/N'
 AND NVL(ar.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD,'?')<>'CAN' AND NVL(dr.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD,'?')<>'CAN'
 AND ar.REAL_LANDIN_TIME>=:period_start AND ar.REAL_LANDIN_TIME<:period_end AND dr.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN service_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_service_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN bridge_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_bridge_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN departure_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_departure_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN board_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_board_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN clean_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_clean_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN meal_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_meal_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN supply_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_supply_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 THEN deice_minutes END),2) AS avg_turnaround_deice_minutes,
 ROUND(100*COUNT(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 AND arr_exec_date=dep_exec_date AND RELEASE_ON_TIME='Y' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN valid_blocks=1 AND arr_exec_date=dep_exec_date THEN 1 END),0),2) AS pair_release_on_time_rate
 FROM pairs

sql.有效座位同航班样本客座率:
WITH flights AS (
 SELECT f.FLIGHT_ID,f.IS_OFF_IN AS direction,f.CRAFT_NO,a.EXEC_DATE,a.FLIGHT_NO,
 a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA||'-'||a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA AS leg,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY f.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD||f.FLIGHT_NO,f.PLAN_TIME,f.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
 FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT a ON a.FLIGHT_ID=f.FLIGHT_ID
 WHERE f.FLIGHT_TASK_CD<>'A/N' AND NVL(a.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD,'?')<>'CAN'
 AND ((f.IS_OFF_IN='D' AND a.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME>=:period_start AND a.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME<:period_end)
 OR(f.IS_OFF_IN='A' AND a.REAL_LANDIN_TIME>=:period_start AND a.REAL_LANDIN_TIME<:period_end))
), production AS (
 SELECT EXEC_DATE,CRAFT_NO,AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD||FLIGHT_NO AS flight_no,LEG,
 SUM(AVAILABLE_SEAT) AS seats,SUM(NVL(ADULT_COUNT,0)+NVL(CHILDREN_COUNT,0)+NVL(BABY_COUNT,0)) AS pax
 FROM FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS WHERE AVAILABLE_SEAT>0
 GROUP BY EXEC_DATE,CRAFT_NO,AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD||FLIGHT_NO,LEG
), eligible AS (
 SELECT f.direction,p.seats,
 CASE WHEN f.direction='D' THEN NVL(t.DEP_DPSR_DEPE_NUM,0) ELSE p.pax END AS pax
 FROM flights f JOIN production p ON p.EXEC_DATE=f.EXEC_DATE AND p.CRAFT_NO=f.CRAFT_NO
 AND p.flight_no=f.FLIGHT_NO AND p.LEG=f.leg
 LEFT JOIN FIMS.TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL t ON t.FLIGHT_ID=f.FLIGHT_ID WHERE f.rn=1
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN pax ELSE 0 END) AS departure_pax,
 SUM(CASE WHEN direction='A' THEN pax ELSE 0 END) AS arrival_pax,SUM(pax) AS total_pax,
 SUM(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN seats ELSE 0 END) AS depart_seat,
 SUM(CASE WHEN direction='A' THEN seats ELSE 0 END) AS arrive_seat,SUM(seats) AS total_seat,
 COUNT(*) AS sample_flights,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN 1 END) AS departure_sample_flights,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN direction='A' THEN 1 END) AS arrival_sample_flights,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN pax ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='D' THEN seats ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS dep_load_factor,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN direction='A' THEN pax ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='A' THEN seats ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS arr_load_factor,
 ROUND(100*SUM(pax)/NULLIF(SUM(seats),0),2) AS total_load_factor FROM eligible
